findings.problem: cwk-guard-api stamp stays 4 while the schema goes 2 -> 3, so install.sh reader_stale lets migrate write v3 under an active stamp-4 reader that rejects it
findings.scenario: reinstall on a 364f906 target: project_config.py lands as .new, migrate rewrites project.json to v3, the old reader refuses it and every hook degrades to kit defaults
findings.closure: project_config.py carries cwk-guard-api 5; a test-install case with a stamp-4 reader and a v2 file shows the file held back as v2 with the stale message

findings.problem: the -U0 patch call does not force --src-prefix=a/ --dst-prefix=b/, so diff.noprefix or diff.mnemonicPrefix in the user's git config drops every added line of tracked files
findings.scenario: user has diff.noprefix=true; a tracked auth hook adds queryClient.clear(); select returns no surface and the critical ship prints not armed
findings.closure: the patch call forces a/ b/ prefixes as kit-gate-route.py:44 does; a test-audit-surface case with diff.noprefix=true in the fixture repo's local config still selects session for an added trigger in a tracked file

findings.problem: the +++ header target is used raw: git appends a TAB for a path with a space and quotes paths with quote/backslash/control chars, so those files' added lines are never matched (and an added line starting with '++ ' is read as a header)
findings.scenario: a tracked 'src/upload/Upload Form.tsx' adds <input type="file">; select returns no surface
findings.closure: added lines are keyed per file from the diff --git block / -z names, not the raw +++ label; a test-audit-surface case with a space in a tracked path selects input-output

findings.problem: server_roots items are validated by _root, which accepts multi-segment values like apps/api, but select matches only the first path segment, so such a root never matches while doctor reports OK
findings.scenario: server_roots ["apps/api"]; a diff under apps/api/routes selects no authz and says no server root touched
findings.closure: server_roots items must be single segments: a multi-segment value is refused (status 3, select exits 2); a test-audit-surface case with server_roots ["apps/api"] exits 2

findings.problem: migrate from a v1 or absent file writes server_roots [] even when the migrated protected_dirs hold an addon's dirs; only v2 derives them
findings.scenario: v1 project with snapshot protected_dirs [src, supabase] reinstalled without --supabase: v3 file with server_roots [], authz never armed for supabase/
findings.closure: migrate from v1 or absent sets server_roots = derived_server_roots(protected_dirs); a test-install case (v1 file + snapshot protected_dirs with supabase) gives ["supabase"]

findings.problem: 1bis says only exit 2 of the selector stops the ship; a crash (exit 1, e.g. an older held-back reader without server_roots, a non-UTF-8 diff) is undefined and can be read as nothing selected
findings.scenario: user merges ship.md.new before project_config.py.new; select raises AttributeError, exit 1; the main thread prints not armed and skips the audit
findings.closure: ship.md 1bis says any non-zero exit of kit-audit-surface.py stops the ship like a red gate; select refuses with exit 2 when the reader lacks server_roots; a contract case pins 'any non-zero exit'

findings.problem: stale 'one /audit:security surface' wording for ship 1bis remains in CLAUDE.md:119, spec.md:25, bmad/pm.md:28, Claude_Workflows.md:506, templates/ci.md:46, RATIONALE.md:224 and :287, contradicting the new 1bis
findings.scenario: a session reads the always-loaded CLAUDE.md exception line and expects exactly one /audit:security surface at ship, while 1bis selects 0..N surfaces and forbids /audit:security <list>
findings.closure: grep for the one-surface ship wording in CLAUDE.md, .claude, docs/Claude_Workflows.md and docs/RATIONALE.md returns no 1bis description

findings.problem: A6's added function is named signOutAll, so the identifier decides and queryClient.clear( is never the deciding trigger; no case pins the cache-reset triggers
findings.scenario: removing queryClient.clear(/.resetQueries(/.removeQueries( from SESSION_TRIGGERS leaves the suite green
findings.closure: an added case whose only trigger is queryClient.removeQueries( in a function with no session identifier asserts ["session"] with that trigger in the reason

findings.problem: A15's docs/ leg uses docs/notes.md, already skipped as *.md, so the docs/ and .claude/ skips are never exercised
findings.scenario: dropping the docs/.claude skip from skipped() leaves the suite green
findings.closure: an added case with a trigger in docs/x.tsx and in .claude/x.ts asserts []

findings.problem: comment prefixes # and * also skip real code lines such as JS private fields (#accessToken = localStorage...)
no --no-textconv on the patch call, and submodule content is never scanned
text=True strict decoding: a non-UTF-8 text file in the diff crashes with a traceback
git diff <rev> has no -- separator, and diff paths are repo-root relative while ls-files and read_lines are cwd relative (project root in a subfolder)
a newline in problem or path injects extra lines into follow-ups.md and defeats the line dedupe
'An explicit user request runs the surfaces the user named, whatever the script returned' can be read as replacing the script's set; and step 5 is not tied to an auditor having run
with server_roots [] a critical ship justified by authz never arms authz, and the prose does not require the 'say so and ask' line in that case
a fresh --fastapi/--supabase install wires server_roots while the just-installed rule says Server roots: none., so doctor reports DIVERGENCE at once
A29/A30 never test the 30-line window edges; A16 never tests href={"/x"}; A13 only tests //; A26-A28 refusals pass an empty stderr needle
T15 checks the bare substring 'diff'; KD11 has no 'none' vs non-empty roots drift leg; no case pins that v3 without server_roots or with duplicates is refused
